company.name: Stillwater
company.description: A meditation and sleep app with a web dashboard for family plans. The family admin manages everything from settings.

title: Stillwater: the family settings page
brief: This is the settings page of Stillwater, as it ships today. Use it like a customer would, then mark every usability problem you find: click the part of the screen, name the problem and say what you saw. Some parts are fine, and flagging them counts against you.

issues.explanation: The toggles are identified only by small icons (an envelope, a calendar, a speech bubble), so people switch notifications on and off by guessing.
issues.fix: Write what each toggle does next to it.

issues.explanation: The plan is described with internal billing codes ('SKU-B2-12', 'T+90', 'auto-renew flag: 1'). The admin cannot tell what they pay, for how many people, or when it renews.
issues.fix: Name the plan, the number of seats, the price and the renewal date in plain words.

issues.explanation: The only button on a long settings page says 'OK'. It does not say that it saves, so people leave without saving, or press it expecting to close something.
issues.fix: Label the button with its action: 'Save changes'.

issues.explanation: Deleting the whole workspace is a big, brand-colored button that looks like the main action and works on a single click, with no confirmation and no undo.
issues.fix: Put irreversible actions in a separate danger zone, style them as destructive, and ask for confirmation (e.g. typing the workspace name).

issues.explanation: An important note about the scope of the change is pale grey on white, below the minimum contrast for body text.
issues.fix: Show the note in readable secondary text with at least 4.5:1 contrast.

hidden.principle: Judge a screen by the user's goal: every element should help them reach it, say clearly what will happen, and tell them what did happen.

toggles: Email me when I am assigned a task

props.text: Notification changes apply to every workspace you belong to.

userGoal: A Stillwater admin wants to update their profile, choose which notifications they get and check their plan.
